description: Search a MusicBrainz entity type with a Lucene query and get back ranked matches with their MBIDs. Plain text matches the entity name; fielded Lucene also works, e.g. `artist:"Miles Davis" AND country:US`, `release:"Kind of Blue" AND format:Vinyl`, or `recording:"So What" AND dur:[540000 TO 560000]`. Feed a returned MBID into musicbrainz_lookup for full detail. Read-only. Data from MusicBrainz (https://musicbrainz.org), the open music encyclopedia.

query.description: Lucene query string (plain text or fielded)

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns MusicBrainz's payload untouched. No field projection: this server has no verified record of which MusicBrainz fields matter, and inventing one would risk dropping a field a caller needs.

name: musicbrainz_search
title: Search MusicBrainz
